description: Security vulnerability waivers with expiry dates. Each waiver documents an accepted risk.

waivers.reason: Transitive dependency via optional Matrix extension (@vector-im/matrix-bot-sdk). Extension is not enabled by default and requires explicit configuration. The deprecated `request` package has no fix available.
Transitive via request → har-validator → ajv in optional Matrix extension. Same chain as request waiver.
Timing comparison hardening in basicAuth/bearerAuth. Used internally by @buape/carbon for Discord bot auth, not user-facing gateway auth. Timing attacks are impractical in this context.
Dev-only dependency (ui → vite → rollup). Not present in production runtime. Path traversal requires malicious build input.
